# Synthetic legacy Office fixtures

`legacy.doc` and `legacy.xls` contain fictional quokka text only. Generated with
python-docx/openpyxl, then converted using LibreOffice's MS Word 97 / MS Excel 97
export filters in isolated temporary profiles. DOC text is repeated because
antiword rejects very small Word text streams. They are parser fixtures, not macros
or executable examples. No private corpus or real person's data is included.
